##### Project general facts

Sofitel Residences by Azha Properties is a branded residence that brings the French art de vivre into everyday life. Designed as a sculpture of light and form, the building combines glass and flowing lines, with decorative facade lighting that gives it a special presence after dark. It rises above a ground floor, a mezzanine and two podium levels to eleven residential floors and two roof levels, offering one- to three-bedroom apartments and four- and five-bedroom penthouses.

Residents enjoy a rooftop swimming pool with its own bar and access to the Sofitel health club with a steam room, a sauna and treatment rooms. A fitness centre inspired by the leisure rooms of French mansions sits alongside a private cinema with a high-end projection system, while the Residents' Club lounge and a children's area with a library, an activity wall and an arts corner welcome families. Concierge, doormen, valet parking, security and owner services complete the offer.

Inside each home, bespoke finishes in soft, calming hues create an immediate sense of ease and refinement. Floor-to-ceiling windows fill the interiors with natural light, complemented by elegant porcelain flooring and tasteful features finished with the savoir-faire of the Sofitel brand. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with fully equipped kitchens and appliances, leaving loose furniture to the owner's own taste and style.

##### Location description and benefits

Downtown Dubai is the vibrant heart of the city, home to Burj Khalifa, The Dubai Mall, the Dubai Fountain and Dubai Opera. Elegant boulevards, landscaped parks, luxury hotels and a wide choice of restaurants and cafes create a lively, cosmopolitan atmosphere throughout the year, while the Burj Khalifa and Business Bay metro stations make the district easy to move around without a car.

Sheikh Zayed Road, Al Khail Road and Financial Centre Road connect residents with the wider city. Burj Khalifa, The Dubai Mall and Dubai Opera are a short walk or drive away, the Dubai International Financial Centre and Business Bay are close by, and Dubai International Airport is within comfortable driving distance, with schools, clinics and supermarkets serving residents nearby.

Downtown Dubai is a freehold district open to international buyers and one of the most prestigious and liquid residential markets in the UAE. Branded residences with hotel-style services are in high demand among high-net-worth buyers and short-stay guests, supporting premium rental rates. Proximity to the main business districts and landmark attractions underpins strong occupancy and long-term value for owners.
